scenes.say: Ever wonder which habits quietly cost you job offers? Let's spot them and fix your answers.
First, stop saying 'we' for everything. Share what you did. Don't just list tools—explain how you used one. Always add numbers to show results. And never blame other teams; focus on your fix.

scenes.label: Record
scenes.sub: Record one answer a day and listen back.
scenes.say: Here's a quick fix: record one answer a day on your phone and listen to spot weak habits.

scenes.question: What if you disagreed with another team?
scenes.wrong: Say they messed up and blame them.
scenes.right: Explain how you focused on the solution and kept things positive.
scenes.say: In interviews, don't blame. Instead, show how you focused on solutions and kept relationships strong.
